body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature within 5 units succeeds on a Reaction.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Turn the moment sideways; that creature becomes Exposed after the Reaction resolves.

surges.html: You or one ally within 3 units gains +1 Defense until the start of its next turn.
The triggering creature cannot make another Reaction until the start of its next turn.
